title: The Visitors from Kampala
subtitle: Sanyu's Growing Heart
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Important visitors arrive and Sanyu must learn the joy of hospitality.
keywords: hospitality, serving, guests, Uganda, girls, virtue, home
dedication: For every girl learning to open her home with a joyful heart.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging books for young African readers.
backCoverText: Visitors are coming! Sanyu just wants to play, but everyone is busy preparing. Can she learn that serving guests is a special gift?
